Posted 'Tusken Raider' dested the Dark Coruscant Tusken Raider (Dark): the strategy has the Tusken Raider at the Podrace Arena 'interfere with opponents destiny' and 'screwing with the opponents race', which is that card's text, not the Premiere one's.
Posted 'Jawa' dested the Dark Premiere Jawa, as in other DeckTech lists; the Coruscant Dark Jawa has the same name.
Posted 'Darth Vader' dested the Premiere Darth Vader; 'Darth Maul' the Tatooine Darth Maul; 'Drop' Drop!.
The strategy suggests subbing Lateral Damage for one Jawa; the list is kept as posted.
